investigation_notes.Description: The alert identified an unusually high volume of SharePoint downloads (250 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 20) by Tomas.Kazlauskas@globalcorp.ee from Vilnius on 2026-02-01 at 12:15 local time. Sample filenames and folder paths are logistics, procurement, and operational documents that align with the user's Supply Chain & Logistics role; the access method (Office 365 SharePoint Online via a standard Chrome user-agent) and timing are consistent with normal business activity. There are no recent related events or similar alerts to suggest lateral or coordinated activity. Given the role-to-data alignment, normal local business-hour timing, and lack of additional suspicious indicators, this activity is assessed as Low Priority.
